name: relayer-graphcomplete
description: Recursive, self-assessing graph completion built on Prime Agent.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && cargo build -p relayer-app-server -p relayer-graph-server && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm run build:packages
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @relayer/graph-client && npm run build -w @relayer/harness-host && npm run build -w @relayer/eval-runner
scripts.check: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && cargo build -p relayer-graph-server && npm run build:packages && tsc --noEmit && npm run check --workspaces --if-present && vitest run && PYTHONPATH=python/relayer-graph/src python3 -m unittest discover -s python/relayer-graph/tests
scripts.test: cargo build -p relayer-graph-server && npm run build:packages && vitest run
scripts.desktop:pack: cargo build --release -p relayer-app-server --target aarch64-apple-darwin && electron-builder --config desktop/packaging/electron-builder.mjs --dir --arm64
scripts.desktop:dist: cargo build --release -p relayer-app-server --target aarch64-apple-darwin && RELAYER_DESKTOP_RELEASE=1 node desktop/release/build-release.mjs stable
scripts.desktop:dist:preview: cargo build --release -p relayer-app-server --target aarch64-apple-darwin && RELAYER_DESKTOP_RELEASE=1 node desktop/release/build-release.mjs preview
